Q5738.reason: The UCC applies to mixed goods/services contracts unless the predominant purpose is services, and here the service agreement is significant.

Q5278.reason: Burglary requires a breaking, and walking through an unlocked door is not a breaking, so the entry element cannot be satisfied.

Q8324.reason: Chronic drug use is toxic to dopamine neurons and gradually destroys them, so dopamine-rich regions lose cells and craving results.
